notes.title: V0.8561 Updates
V0.8555 Updates
Join WotN2 speedrun contest!
notes.content:
Hello, Warriors!
The game has been launched for a week now, thank you for your support and like. The speedrun contest of Warriors of the Nile 2 is coming now! We have prepared two challenge modes for you, with different rewards for different difficulty~
Come and win your customized morph character, Steam gift card and more!

Contest Time; Sep. 2ed -Sep. 20th 

Contest Rules：
Speedrun the Game! Finish the game and the final time that system collected will be your score. We will rank according to the scores.
Warriors can choose any trial mode to participate in.

Normal Trial
You can use any Warrior in your squad.
No need to add challenge and please keep the default difficulty.

Hard Trial
You can’t use morph warrior.
 The challenge mode should be set at the highest level 65 (check all!).

Detailed Rules
1. You can submit your score multiple times, and the score you submitted the last time is your final score.
2. You need to submit your score, recorded footage, victory screenshot, saving file, ID and Discord ID. Your ID is used to display on the ranking list. Please do not use offensive ID and the official has the right to block bad IDs.
3. You can’t unlock Hero Trials when challenging. 
4. MOD, trainer, change gear wheel and other software that affect the game and cheating are prohibited. Once found, the result will be canceled.
5. Hard Trial need to be unlocked in Hard Mode.
6. If the finish time is the same, priority will be given to who submits the score first.
7. The contest will end at 24:00 on September 20, UTC+8.
8. For more details, please join Warriors of the Nile 2 Discord. The ranking list will update every 2 days on 17:00, UTC+8.
9. During the event, due to the update needs of the game version, minor balance adjustments will still be made to some tables and props, and the previous achievements will not be cancelled. At the same time, the warriors are encouraged to continue to challenge. The update is to make the game more perfect, and the impact of this will be respected. Thank you for your understanding.
10. Gamera Games reserves the right of final interpretation of this contest.

Way to Join
Recorded footage, victory screenshot and savingfile of the winning playthrough are needed, please send the materials to support@gameragame.com.

Prizes
Normal Trial
No.1 $200 Steam gift card
No.2 $180 Steam gift card
No.3 $170 Steam gift card
No.4-10 $20 Steam gift card
No.11-20 $10 Steam gift card

Hard Trial
No.1 A customized morph character + $250 Steam gift card
No.2 $200 Steam gift card
No.3 $50 Steam gift card
No.4-10 $30 Steam gift card

Prizes Awarded

1.Within 14 working days after the event ends, the official will contact the corresponding warriors via email to obtain your contact information and issue prizes.
2.The customized morph character needs to be communicated and designed with the winner, and the final decision belongs to the developer. Due to the special workload of the customized morph character, the published time shall be communicated according to the actual situation.

Version 0.8525
notes.content:
Bug fixed:
- Fixed the bug that the completed [Hero Trials] icon was displayed incorrectly under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that [Swift Steps] Tablets couldn’t take effect under certain circumstances. 
- Fixed the bug that specific mistakes would occur when [Spiny Shell] and [Beetle Guard III] co-existed.
- Fixed the bug that [Azure Sword] would do damage around the wrong targets.
- Fixed the bug that [Beetle Bravery] would execute incorrectly under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the mistakes of the wrong pictures of General Charm [Wisdom].
- Fixed the bug that [Desert Guard] would execute incorrectly under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that [Beetle Officer] would execute incorrectly under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that some specific accessories would make wrong results when received.
- Fixed some mistakes in English and Japanese translation
- Adjusted the skill effect of the summonings in [Scorpion Elemental].
- Adjusted the accessories available in the talent list of [Scythe Wielder].

notes.title: Version 0.8520
notes.content:
Bug fixed:
- Fixed the bug that caused the game to stuck when enemy summonings appeared under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that European players would get stuck in attacking when using Berserker.
- Fixed the problems caused by incorrect upgrade effects of player summonings under certain circumstances;
- Adjusted the stat and passive skills of [Imperial Warrior].
- Adjusted the effect of [Blade Pursuit] to prevent the program from being stuck under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that the forward path of [Phantom Claws] was incorrect under certain circumstances. 
- Fixed the bug that Icarus’s summonings could not restore energy to the character when they killed the enemies.
- Fixed the bug that [Star Blitz] could not take effects on specific enemy.
- Fixed the bug that the performance could not play correctly when [Moon Ritual] take effect in the second time.
- Fixed the bug that [Set Warscythe] could not increase attack damage under certain circumstances.
- Fixed the bug that monster kill counts belonged to the wrong account when the battle was settled under certain circumstances
- Fixed some mistakes in description for several Tables and weapons.
- Fixed some mistakes in description for several Tables when translated into English.

notes.content:
Hello, Warriors!

There're still months before the release of Warriors of the Nile 2. While waiting for the launch, we hope you enjoy the demo. That's why we decide to hold the speedrun contest!

Come and win your Nintendo Switch OLED Model, Steam gift card and more!

Contest time: Oct 22nd - Nov 2nd
1. Download and play the demo of Warriors of the Nile 2.
2. You can use any Warrior in your squad.
3. Recorded footage and victory screenshot of the winning playthrough are needed, please send the materials to event@gameragame.com.
4. You can submit your score multiple times.
5. Please let us know your SteamID when submit your score.
6. If the finish time is the same, priority will be given to who submits the score first.

Prizes:
No.1: Nintendo Switch OLED Model + $50 Steam gift card + credit in full game
No.2: $50 Steam gift card + credit in full game
No.3: $30 Steam gift card + credit in full game
No.4-10: $20 Steam gift card + credit in full game
No.11-20: $10 Steam gift card + credit in full game
No.21-50: $5 Steam gift card + credit in full game

Tips: usinng hotkeys is helpful to save time.

For more details please follow Gamera Game Facebook and Twitter.
